titulo: Axalta and ZoomInfo: record-year sales or revenue next to the jobs in the cuts announced after
caption:
Axalta and ZoomInfo: record-year sales or revenue next to the jobs in the cuts announced after

From the archive: 2023 to 2026.

Axalta Coating Systems, Feb 26, 2024
The math: $5.2 billion (2023 net sales, its record-sales year) ÷ about 600 (jobs in the cut announced Feb 2024) = about $8.66 million of 2023 net sales per job cut announced in 2024

ZoomInfo, May 5, 2026
The math: $1.249 billion (2025 revenue, its record-revenue year) ÷ about 600 (jobs in the reduction of May 2026) = about $2.08 million of 2025 revenue per job in the reduction announced in 2026

Record, they said. Here is the per-job column. (Our take.)

Sources: Axalta Coating Systems, Form 8-K, filed Feb 8, 2024; Axalta Coating Systems, Form 8-K, filed Feb 27, 2024; ZoomInfo, Form 8-K, filed Feb 9, 2026; ZoomInfo, Form 8-K, filed May 11, 2026.
